events.title: Sputnik 1 Launch
events.description: The Soviet Union launched the first artificial satellite into Earth orbit.

events.title: Sputnik 2 (Laika)
events.description: The first animal, a dog named Laika, was sent into orbit.

events.title: Explorer 1 Launch
events.description: The first US satellite was launched, discovering the Van Allen radiation belt.

events.title: NASA Founded
events.description: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration was established in the US.

events.title: Luna 1
events.description: The first spacecraft to reach the vicinity of the Moon and leave Earth orbit.

events.title: Luna 2 Impact
events.description: The first man-made object to reach the surface of the Moon.

events.title: Luna 3 Far Side Images
events.description: The first photographs of the far side of the Moon were transmitted to Earth.

events.title: Yuri Gagarin (Vostok 1)
events.description: The first human to travel into space and orbit the Earth.

events.title: Alan Shepard (Freedom 7)
events.description: The first American to travel into space, on a suborbital flight.

events.title: JFK's Moon Goal Speech
events.description: President Kennedy proposed the goal of landing a man on the Moon by the end of the decade.

events.title: Gherman Titov (Vostok 2)
events.description: The second person to orbit the Earth and the first to spend a full day in space.

events.title: John Glenn (Friendship 7)
events.description: The first American to orbit the Earth.

events.title: Telstar 1 Launch
events.description: The first active communications satellite was launched into orbit.

events.title: Mariner 2 Venus Flyby
events.description: The first successful planetary flyby, reaching Venus.

events.title: Valentina Tereshkova (Vostok 6)
events.description: The first woman to travel into space.

events.title: Mariner 4 Mars Flyby
events.description: Transmitted the first close-up images of the Martian surface.

events.title: Alexei Leonov's Spacewalk
events.description: The first human to conduct an extravehicular activity (EVA) in space.

events.title: Ed White's Spacewalk
events.description: The first American to conduct a spacewalk, during Gemini 4.

events.title: Venera 3 Impact
events.description: The first spacecraft to impact the surface of another planet (Venus).

events.title: Luna 9 Moon Landing
events.description: The first spacecraft to achieve a soft landing on the Moon.

events.title: Surveyor 1 Landing
events.description: The first American spacecraft to achieve a soft landing on the Moon.

events.title: Apollo 1 Fire
events.description: A tragic fire during a pre-launch test killed three astronauts.

events.title: Vladimir Komarov (Soyuz 1)
events.description: The first human to die during a space mission.

events.title: Apollo 7 Launch
events.description: The first crewed mission of the Apollo program to reach orbit.

events.title: Apollo 8 Moon Orbit
events.description: The first crewed spacecraft to leave Earth orbit and orbit the Moon.

events.title: Apollo 11 Moon Landing
events.description: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin became the first humans to walk on the Moon.

events.title: Apollo 13 Crisis
events.description: An oxygen tank explosion forced the cancellation of the mission and a perilous return.

events.title: Venera 7 Venus Landing
events.description: The first spacecraft to successfully land on another planet and transmit data.

events.title: Luna 16 Sample Return
events.description: The first robotic probe to return a lunar soil sample to Earth.

events.title: Salyut 1 Launch
events.description: The world's first space station was launched by the Soviet Union.

events.title: Mars 3 Landing
events.description: The first spacecraft to achieve a soft landing on Mars.

events.title: Pioneer 10 Launch
events.description: The first spacecraft to travel through the asteroid belt and visit Jupiter.

events.title: Apollo 17 Landing
events.description: The final mission of the Apollo program and the last time humans walked on the Moon.

events.title: Skylab Launch
events.description: The first United States space station was launched.

events.title: Mariner 10 Mercury Flyby
events.description: The first spacecraft to use gravitational assist to visit another planet.

events.title: Apollo-Soyuz Test Project
events.description: The first joint US-Soviet space flight, docking in orbit.

events.title: Viking 1 Mars Landing
events.description: The first of two probes to successfully land and operate on Mars.

events.title: Voyager 2 Launch
events.description: The only spacecraft to visit all four outer planets (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune).

events.title: Voyager 1 Launch
events.description: The furthest man-made object from Earth and the first to enter interstellar space.

events.title: Pioneer Venus 1
events.description: Conducted the first radar mapping of the surface of Venus.

events.title: Columbia STS-1 Launch
events.description: The first orbital flight of the Space Shuttle program.

events.title: Sally Ride in Space
events.description: Sally Ride became the first American woman to travel into space.

events.title: Guion Bluford in Space
events.description: The first African American to travel into space.

events.title: Challenger Disaster
events.description: The Space Shuttle Challenger broke apart 73 seconds after liftoff.

events.title: Mir Space Station Launch
events.description: The first module of the long-term Soviet/Russian space station was launched.

events.title: Hubble Telescope Launch
events.description: The space telescope that revolutionized astronomy was deployed from the Shuttle.

events.title: Mars Pathfinder Landing
events.description: Deployed the first successful robotic rover, Sojourner, on Mars.

events.title: Cassini-Huygens Launch
events.description: A mission to study Saturn and its moons, including landing on Titan.

events.title: Zarya (ISS) Launch
events.description: The first module of the International Space Station was launched.

events.title: Spirit Rover Landing
events.description: The first of the twin Mars Exploration Rovers landed on the Red Planet.

events.title: Opportunity Rover Landing
events.description: The second of the twin rovers landed, operating for nearly 15 years.

events.title: SpaceShipOne Flight
events.description: The first private spacecraft to reach space twice in two weeks, winning the X Prize.

events.title: New Horizons Launch
events.description: Launched on a mission to visit Pluto and the Kuiper Belt.

events.title: Kepler Telescope Launch
events.description: A mission designed to discover Earth-sized planets orbiting other stars.

events.title: Curiosity Rover Landing
events.description: The car-sized rover landed in Gale Crater to search for evidence of past habitability.

events.title: Rosetta Comet Landing
events.description: The Philae lander achieved the first soft landing on a comet nucleus (67P).

events.title: Pluto Flyby
events.description: New Horizons conducted the first close-up study of Pluto and its moons.

events.title: SpaceX First Land Landing
events.description: The first time an orbital rocket's first stage successfully landed back on land.

events.title: SpaceX First Sea Landing
events.description: The first successful landing of an orbital rocket stage on a drone ship at sea.

events.title: James Webb Telescope Launch
events.description: The most powerful space telescope ever built was launched to study the early universe.
